colors.description: List of color mode options: one or more of '16', '88', '256'. Controls which color charts to display.

mode.description: Display mode: 'block' (default) for block format, 'cube' for cube slices.

numbers.description: Include numeric color escape codes on chart.

hex.description: Include hexadecimal color codes on chart.

rgb.description: Display RGB values as long text (e.g., 'rgb:00/2a/55').

padding.description: Add extra padding between color blocks.

foreground.description: Use color for foreground text instead of background.

convert_88to256.description: Convert given 88-color index N to 256-color index.

convert_256to88.description: Convert given 256-color index N to 88-color index.
